34 participantes; control 9, ejercicio 9: 34 participants; control 9, exercise 9, exercise with testosterone 8, and flywheel 8; 70 days of bed rest.
El entrenamiento combinado atenuó el des: Combined training attenuated muscle and cardiovascular deconditioning. Exercise groups maintained aerobic capacity, while the control group showed an approximately 10% decline. Different resistance modalities were evaluated, with results that must be interpreted by variable.
Comparte programa experimental NASA con: Shares the NASA experimental program with other records. Do not add its participants as an independent cohort without checking overlap.
Astronautas ISS: Sprint 9 y ejercicio es: ISS astronauts: Sprint 9 and standard exercise 17; preflight and postflight assessments.
Comparó un programa de mayor intensidad: Compared higher-intensity, lower-frequency training with standard training. Across both groups, femoral-neck density, knee torque, and aerobic capacity declined, while agility-test time increased. Exercise did not prevent all changes.
Los cambios conjuntos no son diferencias: Pooled changes are not differences caused by Sprint. A longer agility-test time means worse performance, not improvement.
46 astronautas; misiones de 178 ± 48 día: 46 astronauts; missions of 178 ± 48 days and approximately 600 minutes of exercise per week.
Las contramedidas actuales ofrecen prote: Current countermeasures offer partial protection, and individual responses are heterogeneous. The study documents performance changes despite substantial exercise and explores their relevance to future missions.
La estimación de hasta un 17% de limitac: The estimate of up to 17% future limitation is not an observed event rate or the user's risk probability.
24 participantes, incluidas 8 mujeres; 6: 24 participants, including 8 women; 60 days at 6°, continuous or intermittent centrifugation versus control.
La gravedad artificial durante 30 minuto: Artificial gravity for 30 minutes daily attenuated losses in jumping and some plantar-flexion variables, but did not preserve aerobic capacity or all strength measures. Responses depended on the outcome assessed.
No se demostró protección completa. Un p: Complete protection was not demonstrated. An experimental centrifugation protocol is not an individual exercise recommendation.
24 varones sanos; 60 días de reposo, con: 24 healthy men; 60 days of bed rest, control, cycling, and cycling with artificial gravity.
El volumen muscular del muslo disminuyó: Thigh muscle volume declined in all three groups; mean changes were −10.5%, −6.9%, and −4.3%. Torque also declined without clear differences between groups. The combination did not demonstrate overall superiority to exercise alone.
Volumen libre de grasa no equivale a áre: Fat-free volume is not equivalent to cross-sectional area. A difference versus control does not establish superiority to another intervention.
Comparación de vuelo espacial y reposo e: Comparison of spaceflight and bed rest
13 astronautas varones con misiones de s: 13 male astronauts on six-month missions versus 11 men undergoing two months of bed rest without countermeasures.
La pQCT en dos niveles tibiales registró: pQCT at two tibial levels recorded muscle-area losses after flight, with muscle recovery at three months and persistent bone deficits. Flight and bed-rest conditions produced different patterns.
Las edades, duración y contramedidas dif: Age, duration, and countermeasures differ between groups. These tibial regions do not validate quadriceps MRI coefficients.
8 mujeres, 34 ± 4 años; MRI de 17 múscul: 8 women, 34 ± 4 years old; MRI of 17 muscles during 60 days of bed rest.
Todos los músculos estudiados perdieron: All studied muscles lost volume, with large regional differences. The rectus femoris lost approximately 10%, compared with 27–29% in the soleus and gastrocnemii. Comparison with previous male data suggests differences requiring further study.
Comparación histórica, muestra pequeña y: Historical comparison, small sample, and muscle volume. Do not turn this into a universal rule by sex or cross-sectional-area rates.
9 varones sanos de 18–29 años; 21 días d: 9 healthy men aged 18–29; 21 days of horizontal bed rest, EMG, and vastus lateralis biopsies.
Disminuyeron tamaño y contracción máxima: Quadriceps size and maximal contraction declined. Motor-unit changes, reduced neuromuscular transmission at one contraction intensity, and early remodeling or denervation signals were observed.
Hallazgos de un protocolo de 21 días, co: Findings from a 21-day protocol with specialized measurements. They do not allow diagnosis of neuromuscular injury from heart rate or exercise records.
11 varones jóvenes; 10 días de suspensió: 11 young men; 10 days of unilateral suspension followed by 21 days of knee-extensor training.
La descarga redujo volumen del cuádricep: Unloading reduced quadriceps volume and strength by different proportions. Subsequent training restored function and produced metabolic and molecular adaptations specific to prior disuse.
Recuperación terrestre después de descar: Terrestrial recovery after unilateral unloading does not demonstrate in-flight recovery. Recovery percentages use a reference point different from the initial baseline.
Estudio de ejercicio previo en adultos m: Pre-bed-rest exercise study in older adults
10 varones de 65–80 años; una sesión uni: 10 men aged 65–80; one unilateral resistance session before five days of bed rest.
Una sesión previa atenuó la reducción de: One prior session attenuated the reduction in myofibrillar protein synthesis and part of the regional quadriceps-area loss. Both legs lost area; functional and clinical consequences require further investigation.
Comparación entre piernas y regiones, po: Comparison between legs and regions, healthy older population, and short period. Does not establish complete prevention or a regimen transferable to astronauts.
10 varones de 65–80 años; cuatro sesione: 10 men aged 65–80; four unilateral sessions over seven days before five days of bed rest.
La prehabilitación aumentó la síntesis p: Prehabilitation increased protein synthesis before bed rest, but did not prevent its subsequent decline or relative muscle-area loss. No differences between legs were found in quadriceps-area reduction.
Contrasta con el protocolo de una sola s: Contrasts with the single-session protocol in another record: these are not equivalent interventions. Do not generalize universal prehabilitation efficacy.
Ensayo de ejercicio durante reposo en ad: Exercise trial during bed rest in older adults
22 participantes de 55–65 años, 11 mujer: 22 participants aged 55–65, 11 women and 11 men; exercise 11 and passive mobilization 11; 14 days.
El ejercicio mixto mitigó la pérdida de: Mixed exercise mitigated thigh-volume loss, but did not prevent reductions in lean mass, strength, and muscle quality. The study reported recovery after four weeks in the variables assessed.
La recuperación ocurrió en un contexto t: Recovery occurred in a terrestrial context with follow-up. Preserved volume does not mean preserved strength or recovery of all biological mechanisms.
15 participantes de 55–65 años; control: 15 participants aged 55–65; control 7 and exercise 8, 14 days of bed rest at 6°.
El ejercicio atenuó la caída de fuerza d: Exercise attenuated the decline in knee strength and motor-unit-potential area, while lean mass declined similarly. No signs of neuromuscular-junction instability were found with the measures used.
Posible solapamiento con otras publicaci: Possible overlap with other publications from the older-adult program remains to be mapped. Do not compare their results as independent replications or identical variables.
Adultos jóvenes y mayores; cinco días de: Young and older adults; five days of bed rest and unilateral quadriceps stimulation versus the control leg.
La electroestimulación preservó el espes: Electrical stimulation preserved muscle thickness, but not maximal strength. Preservation of the late phase of force development was observed in young participants and did not generalize to older adults.
Espesor, masa magra y función son result: Thickness, lean mass, and function are different outcomes. The number of participants is not specified in this abstract and is not inferred from another publication.
16 adultos jóvenes y 16 mayores; cinco d: 16 young and 16 older adults; five days of bed rest, with one-leg stimulation and contralateral control.
La electroestimulación preservó la activ: Electrical stimulation preserved voluntary activation, but peripheral contractility and maximal strength declined. Improving one neuromuscular component does not guarantee preservation of overall performance.
Posible cohorte compartida con el estudi: A possibly shared cohort with the muscle-thickness study remains to be checked. Do not infer functional efficacy from preserved activation.
19 participantes; control 6 y centrifuga: 19 participants; control 6 and centrifugation 13 during 55 days of bed rest; biopsies on days 6 and 55.
La atrofia de fibras y la rarefacción ca: Fiber atrophy and capillary rarefaction were rapid initially; oxidative-capacity loss then continued without a proportional further capillary reduction. Centrifugation did not prevent these changes.
Área de fibras en biopsia no equivale al: Biopsy fiber area is not equivalent to whole-muscle MRI area. Do not extrapolate initial fiber loss to a daily quadriceps curve.
318 adultos sanos en estudios de 5–120 d: 318 healthy adults in studies of 5–120 days of bed rest.

51 estudios; subconjuntos distintos para: 51 studies; different subsets for aerobic capacity and strength during disuse.

Los tamaños de efecto estandarizados no: Standardized effect sizes are not percentages. Do not sum subsets as if they were independent participants or studies.
Revisión temporal de reposo sin contrame: Temporal review of bed rest without countermeasures
La revisión documenta pérdidas de potenc: The review documents power, strength, and size losses with patterns depending on duration and measurement. It identifies bias and confounding that limit a universal deconditioning trajectory.
Sus categorías temporales no son umbrale: Its temporal categories are not clinical thresholds or safe days without exercise. It does not predict an astronaut's individual course.
Revisión sistemática de ejercicio durant: Systematic review of exercise during bed rest
8 estudios de reposo prolongado, con pro: 8 prolonged-bed-rest studies with heterogeneous protocols, regions, and methods.
El ejercicio atenuó distintas pérdidas m: Exercise attenuated different muscle losses without uniformly eliminating them. The 4.59% hip-bone-loss figure is an outcome from one control study, not a pooled effect or hip muscle loss.
No mezclar área por pQCT con volumen por: Do not mix pQCT area with MRI volume. The review authorizes neither drugs nor a personalized regimen and provides no pooled mean of 4.59%.
Metaanálisis de entrenamiento de resiste: Meta-analysis of resistance training during disuse
11 ensayos aleatorizados, con diferentes: 11 randomized trials with different disuse models and functional or size measures.
El entrenamiento de resistencia mostró e: Resistance training showed favorable effects on several outcomes, with between-study heterogeneity and a need for more high-quality trials. Mean differences must retain each variable's units and definition.
Los valores n de algunos resultados del: Some n values in the abstract count studies, not participants. Do not convert mean differences without explicit units into percentages, doses, or clinical thresholds.
Metaanálisis de ejercicio desde hospital: Meta-analysis of exercise from hospitalization to spaceflight
1754 participantes; 66% varones; escenar: 1754 participants; 66% men; hospital, bed-rest, and spaceflight settings.
Los efectos difieren según contexto y mé: Effects differ by context and statistical method. In hospital settings, the strength benefit persisted after accounting for dependence between outcomes. In bed rest, the effect was no longer significant in the multilevel analysis; in flight, the pooled strength-and-power effect was small and nonsignificant.
No afirmar beneficio universal por el tí: Do not infer a universal benefit from the title. Effect size is not a percentage; prevention and rehabilitation, as well as different mass analyses, are not equivalent comparisons.

86 estudios en revisión y 40 estudios ún: 86 studies in the review and 40 unique studies in the meta-analysis; mostly young adults, with low representation of women and older adults.
